annotation.bound_parties_text: The resolution calls upon the Group of Governmental Experts and the High Contracting Parties to the Convention, encourages all Member States to participate, and requests the Secretary-General to facilitate consultations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: calls upon the High Contracting Parties to the Convention to spare no effort in this regard;
annotation.dates_quote: Resolution adopted by the General Assembly on 2 December 2024
